chunks: And Ishaq ibn Ammar narrated from al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, that he said:
"Assistance descends from the heaven in proportion to the burden of provision and responsibility."

key_terms.الْمَعُونَةُ: assistance, aid, or support granted by Allah
key_terms.عَلَى قَدْرِ الْمَئُونَةِ: in proportion to the burden, expense, or responsibility borne
key_terms.مِنَ السَّمَاءِ: from heaven, indicating divine source and support

ai.seo_question: How does divine assistance relate to a person's responsibilities?
ai.summary: The hadith teaches that divine assistance comes in accordance with the measure of a person's burden and responsibilities. It expresses trust in Allah's support and encourages endurance when obligations increase.
